subject: english
question:
Identify the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the following sentence.

I love the __stunning __view of the mountain.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. **Mundane**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"stunning"** means extremely impressive or attractive; something that is breathtakingly beautiful. (मनमोहक)

 
 
• **Example: **The stunning sunset left everyone in awe.
 
 
 
• **"Mundane" **refers to something that is lacking interest or excitement; dull or ordinary. (निरस)
 
 
• **Example: **She longed to escape her mundane routine and travel the world.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'stunning' **is **'mundane'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. **Mundane**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Toxic **(विषैला): Containing or being poisonous material especially when capable of causing death or serious debilitation.

 
 
• **Example: **The factory was shut down due to the emission of toxic fumes.
 
 
 
• **Superfluous **(अतिरिक्त): Unnecessary, especially through being more than enough.
 
 
• **Example: **She cleared out all the superfluous items from her closet.
 
 
 
• **Smashing **(शानदार): Excellent; wonderful.
 
 
• **Example: **They threw a smashing party to celebrate their victory.
 
 

3e:Td23,

The correct answer is: Option 3
